salt_pct.quote: content of NaCl in total matter increased from 1.4% ± 0.3 (on ripening d1) to 2.5% ± 0.1 (on ripening d180) for Idiazabal cheese

ph.quote: pH was 5.08 ± 0.08 on the first day of ripening, which decreased and reached the lowest values at 30 days (4.91 ± 0.14). Then, up to 120 days, the pH increased close to the initial values (5.11 ± 0.14)

ammonia.reason: Limited surface deamination in pressed low-moisture cheese; modest NH3 from amino-acid deamination.

animal_barnyard.reason: Raw Latxa milk and artisanal lamb rennet paste contribute p-cresol, indole and barnyard fatty acids.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from raw ewe casein and chymosin, partly trimmed by lactobacilli peptidases.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; only low background 2-heptanone and 2-nonanone from fatty-acid beta-oxidation.

browning.reason: Very low residual lactose limits Maillard, but free amino acids allow light browning on heating.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus citrate metabolism yields diacetyl/acetoin, largely volatilized or reduced during long aging.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Lamb pregastric lipase plus raw-milk lipase release abundant C4-C10 free fatty acids, total FFA up to ~50 umol/g.

creaminess.reason: High fat-in-dry-matter ~52% gives mouth-coating, but 32% moisture and firm matrix limit creaminess.

crumbliness.reason: Low moisture, calcium-phosphate solubilization and extended proteolysis create granular fracture.

firmness.reason: Pressed semi-hard paste at ~32% moisture and pH ~5.0 gives firm sliceable body.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol gives light floral note.

fruity.reason: NSLAB esterases esterify free fatty acids to ethyl butanoate and ethyl hexanoate during ripening.

goaty.reason: Sheep-milk short and branched-chain acids including 4-methyloctanoic and C6-C10 acids give sheepy piquancy.

malty_nutty.reason: Extended proteolysis and Strecker aldehydes 2-/3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine give nutty notes.

melt.reason: Rennet-gelled pH ~5.0 paracasein network flows moderately but aged low moisture restricts full melt.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No bloomy rind; only trace 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation.

oil_off.reason: High ewe-milk fat with extensive lipolysis releases free oil on heating.

smoky.reason: Typical unsmoked PDO has no beechwood smoke phenols like guaiacol; smoked version is separate.

sour_vinegar.reason: Starter lactic acid plus very high acetic acid ~26.5 mmol/kg from heterofermentation.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet curd lacks heat-aligned demineralized paracasein for stretching.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low curd heating ~37-38C limits whey-protein denaturation; only mild methionine catabolism to sulfides.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted; slight sweetness from free amino acids, glycerol and propanal.

umami.reason: Chymosin, plasmin and Lactobacillus peptidases accumulate glutamate and savory peptides.
